research.title: Scroll-Driven Animations Are at 82%. The Progressive Enhancement Pattern That Makes That Fine
research.whyTrending: animation-timeline / scroll() / view() are Chromium and Safari only; Firefox 152 still keeps it behind a flag, so it is technically not Baseline. The correct pattern - author the finished state as the default and layer motion on top - is exactly the discipline most React scroll-animation code violates. First-hand material from this blog's own LCP fix.
